newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal EDP dips on Merrill "reduce" call.
newsitem.headline: Portugal EDP dips on Merrill "reduce" call.

text.p: Portugal's EDP eased against the overall market trend, with traders attributing the weakness to a Merrill Lynch "reduce" recommendation.
Traders said that Merrill Lynch had advise clients to reduce their holdings in the stock as a sell over the medium term, although it made EDP a hold or "neutral" over the longer term.
The utility's shares were down 20 escudos at 3,102 escudos compared with a 0.68 percent gain in the PSI20 share index of leading blue chips.
Traders said that the stock appeared to be showing some support at around 3,100 escudos.
But they added that as it was trading at a lower level in New York, it was possible that the 3,100 could be broken.
EDP was partially privatised in June at 2,250 escudo per share.
